name: Shapeshifter's Invitation
descriptionTemplate:
Hand Limit +1. Create a customized "Taboo Trade" at the start of battle. Play "Taboo Trade" to create another on your next turn.
"Taboo Trade" has 4 Arithmetica Cost, {Retain}, {Prepare}, & {Exhaust}, and has 3 custom effects. Playing "Strike," "Defense," or "Skill" Command Cards will enhance its {ordinal:1st}, {ordinal:2nd}, or {ordinal:3rd} effects respectively.
lore: The words on the letter kept changing, always transforming into an irresistible desire.
